thread.title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Shares slipped -0.28% in Pre-market Trade Friday

author: Abby Foster
title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Shares slipped -0.28% in Pre-market Trade Friday
text:
January 19, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Shares slipped -0.28% in Pre-market Trade Friday 
For App Store apps on the web, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) recently introduced an all new design, with a new, cleaner interface, which puts screenshots and critical information front and center. Apple shares shed -0.28% in pre-market trade on Friday. 
On web, one can see the new redesigned interface, just by searching for any iOS or by accessing Mac app. One will see a clear notice, with iOS apps, that one need to open up the App Store to download the application, and with a Mac app, one will get a notice letting you know you need to open up the “Mac App Store”. 
At the movement Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) is under coverage by number of analysts. Buy rating has been given by 17 analysts to the company stock whereas 0 given UNDERPERFORM rating to stock and 7 given HOLD rating. The consensus recommendation by Thomson Reuters analysts is Outperform and their mean rating for the stock is 1.75 on scale of 1-5. Analysts   Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) is $186.30 while their   1.80 (1=Buy, 5=sell). 
The App listings include the icon, screenshots, and app’s name, along with information like star rating, purchase price, ranking, and whether or not there are in-app purchases. 
While an app’s description used to be the first thing that came up when accessing an app on the web, it’s now listed underneath screenshots, which, as 9to5Mac points out, are iPhone X screenshots. App Store webpages also include a listing of what’s new, select reviews, app size, and a list of related apps. 
If we look at stock performance in last active day trading, we see that stock has moved edged up 0.09% to end the day at $179.26.   indicate that stock is -0.07%   50.17%   Abby Foster
